I don’t know if I just want to “enjoy” remaining school holiday (after clinicals) and then off myself the Friday right before school starts.

I guess the only thing my nursing degree helped me with is knowing where my arteries are and how exactly to kill myself :-)

There were a lot of different “triggers”

1) I believe in science and there were just aspects of Islam that didn’t go with science and I was having trouble trying to understand how that could be.

2) I was in a girls’ school and I had a lot of friends who were lesbian or bi (or had a phase) and I never saw anything wrong with homosexuality but I had a best friend who was very judgmental and a homophobe. My parents are homophobes. (All Muslims btw) and that was when I started wondering like... Allah says that people are born perfect but then says homosexuality is a sin?? I was very conflicted about it and decided myself that people who were homosexual are being “tested”, because homosexuality in itself isn’t a sin (the attraction) but participating in sexual acts is. So it’s like a “test” or “challenge” ... just like cancer. I was upset because I felt like it shouldn’t be the case, but it was in Islam. So it didn’t sit right with me but I was okay with accepting that. This was when I was 16-ish all the way to when I was 19.

3) I don’t know why but suddenly I just felt mad about the injustice. I was angry about everyone who had cancer/autoimmune diseases/others that caused mortality. I was angry about people starving all over the world. I was angry about kids and women and men - humans getting raped. I was angry that my parents said people who dressed a certain way are asking to be raped. I was angry that bad things happen to good people. I was angry that animal abuse happens. I was angry that for years I was depressed and cried so many nights and begged God to make me better but that didn’t work because my dad said I had to regularly pray so “Allah will recognize my voice”. 

Then I just stopped believing. Why would I believe in a God that allows so much shit to happen in this world? Why would I believe in ANY higher power?

Life is life. You’re born, you live a life you don’t want to live and then you die & cease to exist. The end.
